characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.description: A consulting detective residing in London who deciphered Porlock's warning and recognizes Professor Moriarty's master-criminal network.

characters.name: Inspector MacDonald
characters.description: An Aberdeen-raised C.I.D. detective from Scotland Yard who consults Holmes regarding the murder at Birlstone.

characters.name: Professor Moriarty
characters.description: A highly talented, respectable-seeming professor who secretly operates as a master criminal commanding a vast criminal organization.

characters.name: Porlock
characters.description: An informant writing under an assumed name who sent Holmes an encrypted warning regarding danger to Douglas.

characters.name: Jean Baptiste Greuze
characters.description: A French artist who flourished between 1750 and 1800, whose valuable painting hangs in Professor Moriarty's study.

characters.name: Jonathan Wild
characters.description: An 18th-century master criminal who organized London's criminals and provided plans in exchange for a fifteen percent commission.

characters.name: Colonel Sebastian Moran
characters.description: Professor Moriarty's chief of staff, paid six thousand pounds a year.

characters.name: John Douglas
characters.description: A wealthy man who spent time in America and the California gold fields before residing at Birlstone Manor House, where he was murdered with a shotgun.

characters.name: White Mason
characters.description: The local police officer at Birlstone and a personal friend of Inspector MacDonald.

characters.name: Hugo de Capus
characters.description: A feudal lord who built the original fortalice at Birlstone during the First Crusade on land granted by the Red King.

characters.name: Mrs. Douglas
characters.description: The wife of John Douglas, a tall, dark, slender English lady twenty years younger than her husband.

locations.name: Birlstone
locations.description: An ancient Sussex village near the Weald forest that is gradually growing into a modern town.

locations.name: Birlstone Manor House
locations.description: An ancient Jacobean brick country house with diamond-paned windows and a forty-foot inner moat fed by a stream.

locations.name: London
locations.description: The metropolis where Holmes, MacDonald, and Professor Moriarty reside.

locations.name: Camberwell
locations.description: A district in London where Porlock's letters were posted and where money was directed to the post office.

relationships.subject: Sherlock Holmes
relationships.explanation: Inspector MacDonald consults Sherlock Holmes on major criminal matters, including the Birlstone murder.

relationships.subject: Inspector MacDonald
relationships.explanation: White Mason is described as a personal friend of Inspector MacDonald.

relationships.subject: Colonel Sebastian Moran
relationships.explanation: Colonel Sebastian Moran serves as chief of staff for Professor Moriarty's criminal organization.

relationships.subject: Porlock
relationships.explanation: Porlock sent Holmes an encrypted warning message regarding danger to John Douglas.

relationships.subject: Mrs. Douglas
relationships.explanation: Mrs. Douglas is married to John Douglas of Birlstone Manor House.

relationships.subject: John Douglas
relationships.explanation: John Douglas has lived at the Manor House of Birlstone for five years.
